cited.quote: There are 20 Institutes of Co-operative Management in the State

rationale: The extracts cover cooperative societies, cooperative education and diploma institutes (C3), and share capital assistance to special societies (C4, C5). None shows a step to select about 40 grade-12 students for enrolment in cooperative societies in every locality. Only related activity.

cited.quote: Hence this Government will urge Government of India to bring necessary Constitutional amendment to achieve this goal

rationale: C1 only states the Government will urge the Union to amend the Constitution for private-sector reservation. That is a statement of intent addressed to the Union, not a formal step urging private companies. C2 to C5 concern other subjects.

cited.quote: The master plan for Phase-I has been completed.
The comprehensive development plan for CKIC has been completed.

rationale: C1 and C2 describe the Chennai-Kanniyakumari Industrial Corridor, a different, ADB-supported corridor whose plans were already complete by 2021-09. C5 names Madurai-Hosur and Coimbatore-Tuticorin freight corridors for logistics study. No extract shows an official step for a Madurai-Thoothukudi industrial corridor.

cited.quote: orders to rationalize the Building Plan Approval fees into a single head of fee for various categories of Development

rationale: C1 is G.O.(Ms) No.180 of 05.12.2024 rationalising and fixing building plan approval fees into a single head. C2 confirms the earlier fee review and standardisation proposal. The fee review for building construction is put into effect by this GO.

No extract is about the ICF second unit or urging the Union to resume its construction. C3 urges the Union only on Chennai Metro Phase II; the others concern metro, aerospace policy, TIDCO and a water resources office.

cited.quote: The Government have framed guidelines for regulating culture of L. vannamei farming outside the jurisdiction
District level surveillance committees have been formed to ensure antibiotic free shrimp production

rationale: Directional promise. C5 reports a GO (Ms) No.05 dated 29.01.2024 framing guidelines to regulate L. vannamei shrimp farming, a dedicated regulatory measure. C3 adds district surveillance committees against antibiotic use. Coastal scope is slightly uncertain and earlier CAA-rule orders (C2) are undated.

cited.quote: This government is prioritizing rural development, in the all-inclusive Dravidian model of government

rationale: Directional promise. No extract shows a Tamil Nadu Rural Development Fund being created. C2 and C4 only restate that rural development is a priority and describe continuing schemes. C1 is about funds under an aerospace policy; C5 is a routine NRLM fund release.

cited.quote: Police hospitals are functioning at 13 places and outpatient medical service centers at 36 places

rationale: Extracts show general police health benefits: free master health check-up, police hospitals (C1, C2, C3), ex-gratia for injured personnel (C3), and extending hospital use to prison and fire staff (C5). None is a scheme of free medical treatment for police injured on duty.

cited.quote: Pilot run is live for 500 buses and 30 bus terminals /depots

rationale: C3 describes a Rs.72.71 crore panic-button and command-control project for MTC buses, still at pilot stage. No extract shows a mandate for GPS and helplines in public and private buses. C1 and C2 cover GPS stop announcements, not a safety mandate.

cited.quote: The Competitive Examinations Coaching Centre at Government Arts College for Men, Nandanam, Chennai, commenced coaching from 23.05.2022

rationale: C1 shows competitive exam coaching centres established in Chennai (coaching from 23.05.2022), Coimbatore (inaugurated 2023), with Madurai and Salem still being prepared. Anna Centenary academies at Madurai and Coimbatore cover UPSC. Trichy and Tirunelveli are not shown.

cited.quote: the translation wing has been extending its support in the implementation of the Tamil official language program in Secretariat

rationale: The extracts show an existing Translation Wing in the Secretariat (established in the British era, C1) and routine inspection and workshops under the Tamil Development Department (C4). No extract shows a new separate wing set up for Tamil as official language across all departments.

cited.quote: Administrative Sanction has been accorded by the Government for the acquisition of 702.29.77 Hectare of Patta

rationale: C1 reports administrative sanction for land acquisition for the new broad gauge line from Madurai to Thoothukudi via Aruppukottai, with acquisition in progress. C2 shows land acquisition 97 to 98 percent done for parts. The track itself is not shown laid, so the commitment is not yet operational.

cited.quote: Continuation of austerity measures on certain major items of expenditure in the year 2022-2023
Ban on purchase of new vehicles shall be continued except for replacement of condemned vehicles

rationale: Directional promise. C1 (G.O.Ms.No.178, 2022-06-20) is a dedicated order enforcing austerity on expenditure items including hospitality, vehicles, furniture and gifts, with cuts per C2. C3 and C5 renew selected measures for 2023-24. Dated in-term GO of this government.

No extract is about the Salem Thoni Maduvu scheme. C1, C2 and C4 are check dams and anicuts on other maduvus in other districts; C3 lists Salem habitations under a tribal scheme; C5 is a Salem watershed climate project.
Extracts C1 to C5 concern Kalaignar Nagarpura Mempattu Thittam, an urban infrastructure scheme, which is a different scheme. None is about reviving Kalaignar Kaapeetu Thittam.

cited.quote: To reduce the detention time, traffic congestion and fatal accidents at Level Crossings

rationale: C1 and C4 describe road over and under bridges and foot over bridges in Chennai, a neighbouring subject. No extract shows foot over bridges with warning devices at unmanned level crossings. C2, C3 and C5 are about general road safety and other matters.
No extract shows any step urging the Union Government to declare Thirukkural a national textbook. C1 only lists Thirukkural cultural events and C2 book releases; C3 to C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: To ensure transparency and efficiency, effective monitoring of the Computer Based Test is essential.

rationale: Directional promise. C3 and C5 are G.O.(Ms) No.01 of 2023-01-03 restructuring the Teachers Recruitment Board, accepting transparency measures such as a centralised monitoring room, third-party audit of computer based tests and standard procedures. C4 shows TNPSC transparency practices.

cited.quote: Administrative Sanction for developing Semmozhi Poonga (Garden of Classical Tamil) in Coimbatore

rationale: C1 and C2 report sanction and works for a new Semmozhi Poonga in Coimbatore and Tholkappia Poonga redevelopment in Chennai. These are different parks. No extract shows refurbishment of the Semmozhi Poonga in Anna Salai.

cited.quote: Coir societies are mainly engaged in activities like fibre extraction, coir spinning, and production of coir mats

rationale: C1 to C3 describe existing coir cooperatives and TANCOFED marketing, and C4 and C5 the Coir Policy 2024 (coir park, testing lab, training). None shows a direct procurement programme through government cooperatives in Salem, Peravurani and Pattukottai.
